description: Direct check for claim-config-publish-requires-durable-append. A single-voter leader is driven through a real AddVoter whose LogStore.StoreLogs call is made to fail once at the real storage boundary. The check observes the one membership-change operation and asks whether the configuration that became configurations.latest has its entry in the durable log.

harness.description: In-package Go test (assurance_generated_test.go) that bootstraps one voter with an InmemStore whose StoreLogs can be failed on demand, waits for leadership, emits the leader-established and change-attempt prerequisites, performs AddVoter with a single injected StoreLogs failure, then emits assurance_config_published carrying whether the published configuration's assigned log index is present in the store.
semantic_changes: One transient LogStore.StoreLogs failure is injected at the real LogStore boundary; no target source is modified
The harness is an added _test.go file in the captured package; observation is emitted as CA_EVENT JSON

legality.derivation: appendConfigurationEntry (bind-append-config) dispatches the configuration entry and then installs the new configuration; dispatchLogs (bind-dispatch-logs) assigns the log index before StoreLogs and returns on error, so the leader can attempt a change whose entry never becomes durable.
legality.applicability: A leader holding a configurationChangeFuture while its LogStore.StoreLogs returns an error for that entry. The failure is supplied by the harness, not produced by real producers.
unresolved: Only one failure timing (whole StoreLogs call fails) is exercised in this direct check; the general set of failure points is covered by the wider investigation
alternatives: A deployment that discards the process on any store error would not run long enough to observe the divergence

grounding.derivation: configurations.latest is documented as the latest configuration in the log/snapshot (src2-configurations-doc), and appendConfigurationEntry publishes the new configuration after dispatchLogs returns (bind-append-config, bind-dispatch-logs). The monitor therefore asks whether the configuration published for this operation has a durable log entry.
grounding.applicability: The admitted membership-change operation is performed by a leader; the result event reports whether the entry assigned to that operation is present in the LogStore.
unresolved: Whether a production LogStore can return a transient StoreLogs error while the process continues

observable_properties.description: For a membership change whose configuration was published as the node's latest configuration, the configuration entry must be present in the durable log.

uncertainties: A single failing StoreLogs timing is observed; other store failure points are outside this direct check
The admitted operation runs in a single-voter cluster, so downstream effects on a multi-voter quorum are not exercised here
